purpose: Exact byte inventory of original analyzed/generated result data already tracked in the source commit; remote branch identity is checked separately.
scope: Byte publication/provenance only; no new statistical validation, empirical survey-law admission, native transfer, or physical detection.
excluded: Upstream raw observational inputs under workdir/raw and external source archives; the already tracked row-level observational extract docs/observational_reboot_20261014/results/gaia_frame_v1/qualified_rows.npz; plots/reports, build profiles/logs, caches outside results and ignored files. Generated synthetic catalogue NPZ/JSON under results are included as analysis outputs.
generation_method: Enumerate the source commit index with git ls-files -s -z under the three included results roots; select the declared data extensions; read each tracked file; compare its computed Git SHA-1 blob object ID with the index ID; record byte length and SHA-256. Worktree was clean before generation.

validation.git_lfs_pointer_assumption: No LFS pointers among 527 included NPZ: each tracked source blob matches local full ZIP bytes; other entries are JSON/CSV

included_derived_observation_note: Some retained results describe real observed cohorts or list IDs, and mixed analysis files contain published compressed observed vectors (including Union3 22-bin summaries and CMB bandpowers). This new inventory excludes the Gaia per-source measurement row archive. Historical Git commits already contain that archive; this metadata publication does not re-upload or remove it.
canonical_digest_serialization: UTF-8 bytes, entries sorted by path; one record per line: path + NUL + decimal byte size + NUL + lowercase SHA-256 + NUL + lowercase Git blob SHA-1 + LF. This is not a JSON serialization digest.
